content.user_title: Build Azure AI Search, Speech, and OCR Workflows
content.value_statement: Azure AI projects often require choosing the right service and SDK pattern. This skill gives concise guidance for Azure AI Search, Speech, OpenAI, Document Intelligence, and related services.
actual_capabilities: Identifies Azure AI services for search, speech, OCR, translation, content safety, and OpenAI workloads.
Lists Azure MCP commands for AI Search index inspection, search queries, transcription, and speech synthesis.
Provides condensed SDK references for Python, TypeScript, .NET, and Java Azure AI clients.
Explains vector search, hybrid search, semantic search, transcription, and document analysis patterns.
Highlights service-specific best practices for authentication, batching, polling, error handling, and cost control.
limitations: It does not provision Azure resources by itself.
It requires configured Azure credentials, endpoints, and permissions for live operations.
It provides condensed references, not complete SDK documentation.
It does not cover Azure Functions, Azure databases, or general Azure resource management.

use_cases.title: Plan search for a RAG application
use_cases.description: Choose Azure AI Search patterns for keyword, vector, hybrid, and semantic retrieval before implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare speech and document ingestion
use_cases.description: Select transcription, OCR, and document analysis patterns for processing audio files and business documents.

use_cases.title: Compare Azure AI service options
use_cases.description: Map requirements to the right Azure AI service and understand preferred tools, SDKs, and authentication choices.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Azure AI service
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Azure AI skill to help me choose a service for [goal]. Include the best service, the reason, and the reference file to read first.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect an AI Search index
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Azure AI skill to outline how I should inspect and query an Azure AI Search index named [index name]. Include the relevant MCP commands.

prompt_templates.title: Design a speech and OCR pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Azure AI skill to plan a pipeline that transcribes audio and extracts text from documents. Include authentication, batching, and error handling considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Architect hybrid retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Azure AI skill to design an Azure AI Search retrieval layer for a RAG app. Compare full-text, vector, hybrid, and semantic ranking, then list implementation risks.

output_examples.input: Which Azure AI service should I use for semantic product search?
output: Recommendation: Use Azure AI Search with hybrid search and semantic ranking.
Next steps: inspect the target index, confirm vector dimensions, and choose filters for product metadata.
Reference: start with the Azure Search Documents quick references for your language.

output_examples.input: How should I transcribe recorded support calls and produce speaker notes?
output: Recommendation: Use Azure AI Speech transcription with diarization enabled.
Implementation notes: prefer batch transcription for long files and capture timestamps for notes.
Operational notes: store audio in approved storage and configure credentials before running live calls.

output_examples.input: What should I use for extracting invoice fields from PDFs?
output: Recommendation: Use Azure AI Document Intelligence with a prebuilt model first.
Next steps: poll long-running analysis operations and review confidence scores before automation.
Escalation: use custom models only when prebuilt extraction does not meet the requirement.

best_practices: Use managed identity or DefaultAzureCredential where the SDK supports it, and keep keys in secret storage.
Start with MCP commands for inspection, then use the SDK references for implementation details.
Match the service pattern to the workload, such as batch transcription, polling, hybrid search, or semantic ranking.
anti_patterns: Using this skill for Azure Functions, Azure databases, or general resource administration.
Treating condensed quick references as complete production security and reliability documentation.
Hardcoding endpoints, keys, SAS tokens, or model names in application source files.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It guides service choice, tool usage, and SDK patterns. Resource creation still requires Azure tools and permissions.

faq.question: Which Azure AI services are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Azure AI Search, Speech, OpenAI, Document Intelligence, Vision, Translation, and Content Safety references.

faq.question: Can it help with vector and hybrid search?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains Azure AI Search patterns for vector search, hybrid search, and semantic ranking.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The generated report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is Azure MCP required?
faq.answer: No. Azure MCP is preferred for supported live actions, but the skill also includes SDK references.

faq.question: Can it replace official Azure documentation?
faq.answer: No. It provides concise starting points and patterns. Use official Azure documentation for full production guidance.
